The '''''Steadfast''''' was an [[Imperial medical transport]] serving in the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Armada]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Great Galactic War]]. It participated in the [[Sacking of Coruscant]].
